page.content:
Shared media repository that Wikipedia editions draw images from.

How Wikimedia Commons connects

  • Faction: Wikimedia Foundation — Commons is a Wikimedia Foundation sister project.
  • Work: English Wikipedia — Commons supplies freely licensed files to English Wikipedia articles.

What is Wikimedia Commons?

Wikimedia Commons is the free-file depot for photographs, diagrams, and scans reused across language Wikipedias under open licenses.

Key threads lead to Wikimedia Foundation and English Wikipedia.

copyright.body: Wikipedia, related names, marks, and materials are the property of Wikimedia Foundation / contributors (CC licenses). Ton-o-Lore is an independent educational encyclopedia project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by those rights holders. Identification marks, when shown, are low-resolution images used under a fair-use rationale for commentary and identification only — not free or redistributable artwork.
